notes: CRN MC ranking reports budget; measure with informative tag should not lose to tiny sampling on average.
evidence_proposition: Ranking two declared design candidates through a prepared study returns both, takes one exact sample or at least min_mc_samples Monte Carlo samples, orders the scores, and puts a measurement or sampling candidate first.
limitations: An ordering and budget-contract check on one fixed three-graph sample. No expected-information-gain value is derived or compared against an independent calculation, and the ordering inequality is not a theorem about the objective. No calibration.
